features: DUAL LENS DUAL SCREEN — 180 DEGREE BLIND-SPOT-FREE COVERAGE: Two independent 3MP lenses stream simultaneously — wide-angle plus zoom — eliminating the blind spots single-lens cameras leave behind.
IP66 WEATHERPROOF BUILD: Fully waterproof and dustproof housing withstands heavy monsoon rains, extreme heat, and dust storms — designed for reliable year-round outdoor use across all Indian seasons.

COLOUR NIGHT VISION UP TO 10 METRES: Grousale's full-colour night vision identifies faces, clothing colours, and vehicle number plates clearly even in complete darkness — far superior to black-and-white IR-only cameras.

AI MOTION DETECTION WITH INSTANT ALERTS: Smart human-detection sends real-time push notifications to your phone the moment movement is detected — filtering false alarms from animals or trees, 24 hours a day.
TWO-WAY AUDIO: Built-in microphone and speaker let you hear and speak through the camera using the app — warn intruders, communicate with family, or answer visitors from anywhere in India.
